items.title: RI's Michael Kaess named to inaugural Office of Naval Research Chief of Naval Research Fellows Program
items.summary_en: Michael Kaess, an associate professor in CMU's Robotics Institute and director of the Robot Perception Lab, was named one of 12 inaugural fellows in the U.S. Office of Naval Research's new Chief of Naval Research (CNR) Fellows program, selected from more than 180 nominations across about 70 institutions. The one-year fellowship gives him direct engagement with Navy and Marine Corps science-and-technology challenges related to his research on mobile robot mapping, perception, and navigation.

items.title: Skylark Labs and CMU Robotics Institute researchers partner on 'Artisan' robot manipulation AI
items.summary_en: Skylark Labs announced a multi-year research partnership with the labs of CMU Robotics Institute professors Jeff Schneider and Zackory Erickson to develop 'Artisan,' an AI model intended to help robots grasp and manipulate previously unseen objects with varying shape, texture, and weight. Both professors serve on Skylark Labs' technical advisory board; the work will be conducted at Carnegie Mellon.
